permanent_loss_constraints.condition: Unified sales or higher volume does not establish value creation if customer response, price-cost economics, owner cash or financing resilience are unobserved or deteriorate.
permanent_loss_constraints.required_treatment: Settle atomic fields separately; do not infer action effect, management quality, capital return or permanent loss from an aggregate result.

decision_flip_questions.statement: Did the February 2015 unified-sales launch operate at disclosed scope and generate direct customer or channel response?
decision_flip_questions.decision_effect: Without operating scope and customer evidence, later sales cannot establish execution of the commercial mechanism.

decision_flip_questions.statement: Did separate volume, price, unit-cost, selling-expense and cement-margin fields show economically useful progress?
decision_flip_questions.decision_effect: Volume that is purchased through price, expense or capital deterioration does not support the mechanism.

decision_flip_questions.statement: Did working capital and operating cash improve relative to capex and financing burden?
decision_flip_questions.decision_effect: Persistent funding dependence can contradict value creation even when operations improve.

arenas.product_or_service_scope: cement and commodity clinker manufactured and sold in Fujian
arenas.customer_task: secure locally delivered cement supply for construction and distribution demand
arenas.competition_mechanism: regional supply-demand, delivered price, coordinated sales reach, logistics availability and unit-cost competition
arenas.window: FY2014 cutoff state and FY2015 commercial-operating plan

operating_variables.name: Furun unified-sales launch and operating scope
cement realized price, unit cost and gross margin
cash capex and short-term financing burden
direct impairment, default or going-concern condition

mechanisms.description: The February 2015 unified-sales launch may coordinate channel reach and market conduct, but operating scope and direct customer response remain to be observed.
Separate cement and clinker volume must be read with realized price, unit cost, selling expense and cement margin before commercial progress can be judged.
Operating economics transmit to investor value only after receivables, inventory, operating cash, cash capex and financing burden are observed separately.

financial_transmissions.description: Unified sales can affect volume only if operating scope and customer response become observable.
The net direction depends on separate volume, price, cost, expense and margin fields.
Operating cash is not owner cash until working capital and cash capex are separated.
Financing and project burden identify a question, not a durable loss conclusion.

events.responsible_party: issuer management participating in the Furun unified-sales arrangement
events.problem_statement: Coordinate sales and market conduct in a Fujian cement market exposed to weak demand, excess capacity and falling prices.
events.strongest_counterargument: Regional demand, industry pricing, capacity utilization and input-cost movements can explain later volume, margin or cash without Furun execution or customer response.
unknowns: durable capital return and loss exposure

feedback_loops.selection_rationale: The cutoff filing dates the unified-sales launch but leaves its operating scope and customer response open for the next period.
The FY2014 baseline shows price, cost and expense can move differently, so no aggregate revenue or profit shortcut is allowed.
High capex and financing dependence require cash, capital burden and loss events to remain separate from operating progress.

decision_observation.materiality_scope: Issuer participation in the February 2015 Furun unified-sales launch; further channel and logistics actions remain plans.
decision_observation.rationale: The official cutoff filing states that unified sales began in February 2015. It does not establish FY2015 operating scope, customer response, execution quality or action effect.
decision_observation.next_discriminating_evidence: The next filing must provide contract-matched atomic execution, customer, volume, price, cost, expense, working-capital, cash, capex, debt and loss fields.

question_set.question: Did the February 2015 unified-sales launch operate at meaningful scope and produce direct customer or channel response?
Did separate volume, price, unit cost, selling expense and cement margin support economically useful progress?
Did working capital and operating cash improve relative to capex and short-term financing burden?
Did a direct impairment, default or going-concern event change permanent-loss exposure?

claims.statement: The cutoff filing states that Furun unified sales began in February 2015; operating scope and execution remain unknown.
Unified sales may affect customer response and separate cement or clinker volume, while regional demand, price and capacity remain rival explanations.
Commercial progress requires separate price, unit-cost, selling-expense and cement-margin observations.
Receivables, inventory, operating cash, cash capex and debt must remain atomic before owner-cash or capital conclusions.
One-year operating change cannot establish permanent loss without a direct impairment, default or going-concern event and durable follow-up.

hypotheses.statement: The unified-sales launch operates at meaningful scope and is accompanied by direct customer response and component-level volume progress.
Operating scope or customer response remains unobserved, or regional demand, price and capacity explain volume at least as well.
Component volume progress survives price, unit-cost and selling-expense pressure and preserves or improves cement gross margin.
Price, unit cost or selling expense absorbs any component volume progress.
Working capital and operating cash improve relative to cash capex and short-term financing burden without a direct loss event.
Working capital, capex, financing or direct loss events consume operating progress and leave capital resilience unresolved or worse.
The unified-sales launch operates at meaningful scope and is accompanied by direct customer response and component-level volume progress.
Operating scope or customer response remains unobserved, or regional demand, price and capacity explain volume at least as well.

evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_a: Operating scope and direct customer response are observed with component-level volume progress.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_b: Scope or customer response is absent, or external market conditions remain at least as plausible.

hypotheses.statement: Component volume progress survives price, unit-cost and selling-expense pressure and preserves or improves cement gross margin.
Price, unit cost or selling expense absorbs any component volume progress.

evidence_discriminator.observable: Separate cement/clinker volume, cement realized price, unit cost, selling expense and cement gross margin.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_a: Margin is preserved or improves after price, cost and expense are separated.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_b: Price, unit cost or selling expense offsets component-volume progress.

hypotheses.statement: Working capital and operating cash improve relative to cash capex and short-term financing burden without a direct loss event.
Working capital, capex, financing or direct loss events consume operating progress and leave capital resilience unresolved or worse.

evidence_discriminator.observable: Atomic receivables, inventory, operating cash, cash capex, short-term debt and direct loss-event fields.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_a: Cash and working capital improve relative to capital and financing burden without a direct loss event.
evidence_discriminator.expected_if_h_b: Working capital, capex, debt or a direct loss event offsets operating progress.

thread_combination_rules.rule: Report each atomic label. H-A cannot be taught as supported unless operating scope and direct customer response are OBSERVED_YES; component volume alone never substitutes.
thread_combination_rules.conflict_rule: Preserve every local label; conflicting volume components or missing customer evidence keep mechanism attribution unresolved.

thread_combination_rules.rule: Preserve price, unit cost, selling expense and cement margin separately; no aggregate profit or revenue label may replace them.
thread_combination_rules.conflict_rule: A mismatch or unknown remains local and produces a partial unit-economics view rather than an episode failure.

thread_combination_rules.rule: Report working capital, operating cash, cash capex, debt and direct loss events separately; one-year values do not settle owner cash, capital return or permanence.
thread_combination_rules.conflict_rule: Mixed atomic directions remain mixed; no sibling can overwrite another and no causal attribution is generated.

strongest_rival.statement: Regional demand, industry pricing, capacity utilization and input-cost movements can explain later volume, margin or cash without Furun operating scope, customer response or action effect.
break_conditions: No explicit FY2015 Furun operating scope or direct customer response.
Component volume changes are unavailable or conflict with price, unit-cost, selling-expense and cement-margin fields.
Operating cash improves only while inventory, cash capex or short-term financing burden worsens.
Only subsidiary-local or one-year loss evidence is available for the permanent-loss question.
